state.brief: A full marketing website for Seenry, a free open-source design skill for coding agents. A new visitor needs to understand what it produces, inspect a meaningful working example, and install. Audience: developers who can ship functional code but want stronger composition and coherent visual detail.
facts: Existing local Held furniture-restoration website is an authored teaching study, not an independently measured skill result.
No customer testimonials or conversion results are available.
requirements: Hero includes its entire associated visual even below first viewport.
Each subsequent section answers a new visitor question.
Footer provides real project and install links.

evidence.inspection: Desktop segment 0 inspected at reduced scale for macro page structure only. Large opening product visual; distinct subsequent product chapters. This does not establish readable fine typography or motion quality.
evidence.not_transferred: No Linear logos, copy, code, customer claims or screenshots will become Seenry product assets.

state.limits: Choose text-described information structure only. You have not seen the images. Do not infer visual quality from descriptions.

reading_order.instructions: Which offered page reading order best helps the new visitor in `brief` understand the actual offering and inspect its evidence before installation? Compare only the described structure, not unseen aesthetics.

criteria.none: None of these reading orders fits the brief; return to the main design agent with the unresolved decision.
criteria.gallery_first: Open with a full-screen image montage and a short brand line; show selected examples; explain the offering and installation after the gallery.
criteria.package_first: Introduce the offering; list every skill package and tool; show installation; place the working website example near the footer.
criteria.proof_first: Introduce the offering and install action; show a substantial working website example; let visitors explore layout, motion and asset decisions in context; explain optional references and limitations; provide installation and footer navigation.

hero_evidence.instructions: Which offered opening evidence best substantiates the website-design capability in `brief`, using the available facts without fabricated results?

criteria.none: Available evidence is insufficient; obtain relevant material.
criteria.testimonials: Invented customer endorsements and an unsupported quality score.
criteria.tool_diagram: A diagram of internal skill files and model calls as the main hero visual.
criteria.working_site: A clearly labeled authored full website study with a working interaction, sufficient hero coverage and a link to the entire page.
